text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.

text: I hunted Sonnet for flip-flopping and that was the doctor; I should have trusted Gemma's Terra read instead of my own tempo. Good read, Haiku.

Gemma claimed officer on Day 1 and named Terra as a killer, and she was telling the truth. Terra was voted out that same day, and the killers took Gemma on Night 2. On Day 2 Opus was voted out in a runoff, and he was a citizen. Night 3 took Sonnet, the doctor, and on Day 3 Sol's shifting protection story got Sol voted out. Every killer was out by Day 3, so the town won.
